changeSet.sql:
SELECT setval( 'public.utm_configuration_parameter_id_seq', GREATEST((SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 1) FROM public.utm_configuration_parameter), 42), true );
INSERT INTO public.utm_configuration_parameter ( section_id, conf_param_short, conf_param_large, conf_param_description, conf_param_value, conf_param_required, conf_param_datatype, modification_time, modification_user, conf_param_option, conf_param_regexp ) SELECT 10, 'utmstack.tw.allowlist', 'Allowlist (IPs, CIDRs, Domains)', 'IP addresses, CIDR ranges, or domains/hostnames excluded from Threat Intelligence feed alerts.', '', false, 'allowlist', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.utm_configuration_parameter WHERE conf_param_short = 'utmstack.tw.allowlist' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.utm_configuration_section WHERE id = 10 );
